notes: Ibn Umar's praying after the Friday prayer is described as an action, so he is not a link (rule 6); the chain ends at عطاء
«قلت لعطاء ... قال مرارا» is the same link answering, not a new one
«ورواه عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان ولم يتمه» is a variant remark naming another transmitter: variant group
